name: gantt-planner
description: Turn a simple task list into a Gantt chart with real working-day dates. List tasks with durations in workdays, who owns them and what they depend on; the planner schedules each task the workday after its predecessors finish, skips weekends and the holidays you list, marks milestones and highlights the critical path — the chain of tasks that sets the finish date. Fix a start date, change a duration or a dependency and every date moves. Export the chart as SVG and PNG, the schedule as Excel, and an HTML page. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把一张简单的任务清单变成带真实工作日日期的甘特图。写上任务、工期（工作日）、负责人和前置任务，插件会让每个任务在前置任务完成后的下一个工作日开始，跳过周末和你列出的节假日，标出里程碑，并高亮关键路径——决定完工日期的那条任务链。指定开始日期、改工期或改依赖，所有日期自动跟着变。导出 SVG 和 PNG 甘特图、Excel 排期表和网页。在本地运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
